figurative_meaning_en: Initiating children into basic writing lessons
example_sentences_in_bangla: গ্রামের স্কুলে শিক্ষক ছেলেটিকে তক্তি হাতে দিয়ে লেখা শেখাতে শুরু করলেন।
দাদু নাতিকে তক্তি হাতে দিয়ে প্রথম অক্ষর লিখতে সাহায্য করলেন।
example_sentences_in_english: In the village school, the teacher gave the boy a slate to start his writing lessons.
Grandfather helped his grandson by giving him a slate to write his first letters.
history: This idiom originates from traditional Bengali village education where children used slates (তক্তি) for initial writing practice before modern notebooks.
note: Refers to the cultural practice of pathshala or informal schooling in rural Bengal.
